name: limit_radius_too_big_for_the_edge
why: A radius of 25 on an edge of 40 does not fit: it would need 50 of edge. It is refused BEFORE trying, saying how long the edge is -- because whoever asked for 25 does not have it in front of them. Without the check, SOLIDWORKS would answer only that the fillet was not created, which is true and useless.
_why_the_biggest: the check looks at the LARGER of the two radii: a fillet that starts at 3 and ends at 25 fails because of the 25, and saying «3 fits» would be a half truth.

message_includes: not even half of it fits
